design_gates.name: staged corpus roles and exclusions frozen

acquisition_gates.name: human corpus decision
acquisition_gates.condition: One allowed choice is recorded with scope and reviewer authority.

acquisition_gates.name: source authorization and release terms
acquisition_gates.condition: Written authorization/terms and retention approval are attached for every source.

acquisition_gates.name: pre-transfer object manifest
acquisition_gates.condition: Exact provider object IDs, source revisions, selected groups, and byte estimates are frozen before transfer.

acquisition_gates.name: bounded transfer and checksums
acquisition_gates.condition: Only approved caps are transferred; per-object and extracted-file SHA-256 lists verify.

acquisition_gates.name: encoder compatibility
acquisition_gates.condition: Raw records normalize to finite x [N,32], edge_index [2,E] under the authenticated encoder; adapter errors are accounted for.

training_release_gates.name: corpus hash manifest
training_release_gates.condition: Immutable raw/graph/feature checksum manifests are complete.

training_release_gates.name: materialized split manifest
training_release_gates.condition: Every group has a deterministic digest, partition, source, and contract hash; no overlap.

training_release_gates.name: contamination audit
training_release_gates.condition: Denylist, duplicate, cross-group, time-overlap, and feature-dependency audits are clear.

training_release_gates.name: class-count and coverage audit
training_release_gates.condition: Required classes and process/file/socket coverage exist in train/validation/calibration without reassignment.

training_release_gates.name: train/eval exclusion check
training_release_gates.condition: FA1B2de and Track O evaluation metadata are absent from all Track-L fitting/tuning/calibration inputs.

training_release_gates.name: search registration
training_release_gates.condition: The exact R5 candidate grid, seeds, dependency lock, and calibration rule are recorded before fitting.

training_release_gates.name: separate human training authorization
training_release_gates.condition: A later reviewer authorizes detector training after T0-T5 pass.

formal_evaluation_gate.condition: A new authenticated 32D checkpoint, frozen calibration, and formal-evaluation manifest exist; R3 exclusion remains binding.

current_state.next_action: Record a human acquisition choice; do not proceed automatically.
